name: Viktorias Home
beschreibung: Viktorias Home is located in the center of Kufstein, just a few minutes' walk from Festung Kufstein and the pedestrian zone. The house offers cozily furnished rooms with a view of the city or the surrounding mountains. Guests appreciate the quiet location in a historic building, while shops, restaurants, and cafés are within walking distance. A small breakfast selection is included in the price.
